description: Find which app marketplaces list a company, with installs, ratings, and listing URLs.

tool_signatures.name: get_marketplace_presence
tool_signatures.description: Find which app marketplaces list a company. Give a company domain (for example klaviyo.com), optionally its name, or a list of domains. Checks HubSpot App Marketplace, Salesforce AppExchange, Slack Marketplace, Zapier, Shopify App Store, Atlassian Marketplace, Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Marketplace, Google Workspace Marketplace, and the WordPress plugin directory, and returns one row per company with, for each marketplace, the listing URL, listing name, installs, rating, review count, last update, a status (listed, not_found, blocked, skipped), and a match confidence (1.0 linked from the company site, 0.9 listing names the company domain, 0.7 name match only). Companies with no listing come back free with row_status not_listed. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per listing found.
